27.02.2025 CLR No.15 of 2025
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
An amendment application was filed 
by the proposed revisionist-judgment debtor 
in her objection filed under Section 47 of 
the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. The said 
amendment application has been dismissed 
vide impugned order dated 25.01.2025,
passed by the learned IInd Additional 
District Judge, Haridwar in Misc. Case No.14 
of 2024. 
2. Mr. Siddhartha Sah with Mr. Pankaj 
Kaushik, learned counsel for the proposed 
revisionist and Mr. Sudhir Kumar, learned 
counsel for the respondent. Mr. Pankaj 
Kaushik, Advocate is present through video 
conferencing.
3. On 24.02.2025, Mr. Siddhartha Sah, 
Advocate sought two days’ time to provide 
copies to Mr. Sudhir Kumar, Advocate. 
4. Copies have been provided to Mr. 
Sudhir Kumar, Advocate. He has sought four 
days’ time to file his vakalatnama. 
5. Time is granted.
6. Mr. Siddhartha Sah, Advocate 
submitted that today is the date fixed 
before the IInd Additional District Judge for 
disposal of the objection, filed under Section  47 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908.
7. On the joint request, list on 
06.03.2025.
8. Till then, further proceedings of Misc. 
Case No.14 of 2024 are stayed.
9. Stay Application (IA No.1 of 2025) 
stands disposed of accordingly. 
10. It is made clear that the said interim 
order shall not be extended on the date 
fixed only on the request of the proposed 
revisionist. 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
JKJ/Pant 27.02.2025
